title: From NIL deals to retirement at 35: JPMorgan aims to help athletes avoid bad money habits
title_zh: 从零交易到 35 岁退休：摩根大通旨在帮助运动员避免不良的金钱习惯
summary: JPMorgan Chase said Wednesday that it will start building wealth advising services that help athletes who come into money as a result of their talents make that money work for them a long time.
summary_zh: 摩根大通周三表示，将开始建立财富咨询服务，帮助那些因天赋而致富的运动员，让这些钱为他们服务很长时间。

title: Oracle's "Halo Effect" Is the Real Deal. But is the AI Growth Stock a Buy in March?
title_zh: 甲骨文的“光环效应”是实实在在的。但人工智能成长股在三月份值得买入吗？
summary: Down big off its high, the sell-off in Oracle could be a buying opportunity for risk-tolerant investors.
summary_zh: 甲骨文的抛售从高点大幅下跌，对于承受风险的投资者来说可能是一个买入机会。

title: Is KKR’s (KKR) Deal Juggling Amid Liquidity Strains Reframing Its Private Markets Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 在流动性紧张的情况下进行的交易是否正在重新制定其私募市场策略？
summary: In recent days, KKR has reportedly joined the bidding for Pacific Equity Partners-owned UP Education, which could fetch more than A$1.00 billion, while also exploring a potential sale of liquid-cooling provider CoolIT Systems in a deal that may exceed US$3.00 billion.
summary_zh: 据报道，最近几天，KKR 加入了对 Pacific Equity Partners 旗下的 UP Education 的竞购，该交易的售价可能超过 10 亿澳元，同时还在探索出售液冷供应商 CoolIT Systems 的可能性，交易金额可能超过 30 亿美元。
